exact_statement: Let c(p)=2*h2(p)-h2((1-2*p)^2)/2 for real p in[0,1]. There is exactly one p_star in(0,1/2) solving p*c_prime(p)-c(p)=0, and lambda_star=c(p_star)/p_star is the LEAST constant with c(p)<=lambda_star*p for every real p in[0,1], equivalently for every bias realizable by finite uniform Boolean cores. It satisfies487/100<lambda_star<39/8, with the exact192-bit root and price enclosures in out/CRITICAL_POINT.json. For every finite uniform Boolean g, a distinct independent balanced physical bit y, and EACH FIXED real K>=lambda_star, the full stopping deficit hull satisfies R_K(AND_minus(g,y))=R_K(g)/2. In particular every real K>=39/8 suffices, improving the source sufficient K>=8. For every integer m>=0 fresh balanced AND guards, R_K(F_m)=2^(-m)*R_K(g), including all adaptive physical reveal/stopping histories. The complete correction is paid by the ORIGINAL distinct guard influence owners: each guard in the final F_m has influence2^(-(m-1))*Pr(g=-1), and total correction is at most lambda_star*m*2^(-(m-1))*Pr(g=-1). All real supplied surpluses above this coherent hull bank are covered by affine credit shifts with old owner/debit labels and full outcomes retained. The scalar bound is sharp; no optimality of lambda_star as a full-hull-contraction threshold is asserted. Initial influence pricing of an arbitrary R_K(g), general active-core composition and full FEI remain open.
